5.finding: The model uses held_office, outside the frozen relation synonym list. Its literal holder intervals agree with the evidence, but those assertions do not receive a positive automated temporal score because their relationship matching is unresolved. All four assertions add believes attributions absent from the direct narration. Unsupported attribution is a real evidence-grounding failure, independent of the relation-wording limitation. The depicted responsibilities remain attached to the shared office.

6.finding: Harbor Warden office is not among the prospectively allowed office-name aliases; held_by is an inverse expression outside the frozen predicate matching rules. Neither is automatically classified as a false officeholding claim. The numerical intervals agree with the supplied text, but unresolved graph mapping prevents formal qualification credit. The model additionally invents believes attribution for officeholders and uses the invalid epistemic attitude has responsibility with the office as holder. Those epistemic fields are not supported by the narrated facts.

7.finding: All underlying bindings, supplied citation IDs and explicit holder intervals match the fresh evidence under the frozen evaluator. Both officeholding assertions nevertheless add unsupported believes attribution. The two direct office-responsibility assertions omit epistemic fields correctly and are complete matches. This is an epistemic-scope failure, not a wrong-date failure.

8.finding: Officeholder assertions use inverse held_by wording, which remains unresolved by the frozen matcher; their written dates match the evidence. They also populate holder and attitude=holds, using epistemic fields for office occupancy rather than supported attribution. The two office-responsibility facts are complete matches. No inverse translation was added after seeing this answer.

office_interpretation.fresh: The frozen mechanical comparator labels changed directed bindings as different fact selection within the same office-mediated organization. That label is not evidence of different selected meanings: the changed edges use held_by in the inverse direction, outside the frozen equivalence rules. The evidence supports only a predicate/direction difference with organization still office-mediated; selection equivalence remains formally unresolved. No construction contrast is established.
office_interpretation.original: The automatic comparison is unresolved because the continuity answer uses an unlisted office-name suffix and inverse predicate. Visually both answers retain one shared office linked to occupants and responsibilities. No semantic-organization change is established.

manual_interpretation.remaining_limitation: The clarified belief format works on the revised original and fresh belief passages, but it does not prevent misuse of epistemic fields in office narratives. Some office wording is outside the frozen matcher's coverage. The office question/reference pairs also permit identical organization, so this batch cannot establish the intended construction contrast.
manual_interpretation.scope: Post-generation manual interpretation only; not an independent review, new normalization, re-scoring, or model repair. Original and v2 frozen scores remain unchanged.
